records.question: How many customers are there?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TotalCustomers FROM Customer LIMIT 50

records.question: How many tracks are there in total?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track LIMIT 50

records.question: List the names of all genres.
records.sql: SELECT Name FROM Genre LIMIT 50

records.question: What are the first and last names of the customers from Brazil?
records.sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil' LIMIT 50

records.question: Show the names and lengths in milliseconds of the 5 longest tracks.
records.sql: SELECT Name, Milliseconds FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 5

records.question: How many invoices were issued in 2023?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS InvoiceCount FROM Invoice WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2023' LIMIT 50

records.question: What is the average invoice total, rounded to 2 decimal places?
records.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(Total), 2) AS AvgInvoiceTotal FROM Invoice LIMIT 50

records.question: What are the first and last names of the employees whose title is 'Sales Support Agent'?
records.sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Employee WHERE Title = 'Sales Support Agent' LIMIT 50

records.question: How many different countries do the customers come from?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Country) AS CountryCount FROM Customer LIMIT 50

records.question: List the names of all media types.
records.sql: SELECT Name FROM MediaType LIMIT 50

records.question: How many albums are there?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS album_count FROM Album LIMIT 50

records.question: How many tracks cost more than 0.99?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE UnitPrice > 0.99 LIMIT 50

records.question: What is the largest invoice total?
records.sql: SELECT MAX(Total) AS LargestInvoiceTotal FROM Invoice LIMIT 50

records.question: How many customers have no company listed?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS NumCustomersWithoutCompany FROM Customer WHERE Company IS NULL OR Company = '' LIMIT 50

records.question: What is the earliest hire date among the employees?
records.sql: SELECT MIN(HireDate) AS EarliestHireDate FROM Employee LIMIT 50

records.question: What are the titles of all albums by AC/DC?
records.sql: SELECT Album.Title FROM Album JOIN Artist ON Album.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId WHERE Artist.Name = 'AC/DC' LIMIT 50

records.question: How many tracks does each genre have? Show the genre name and the track count.
records.sql: SELECT g.Name AS GenreName, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Genre AS g LEFT JOIN Track AS t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.Name LIMIT 50

records.question: Who are the top 5 customers by total spending? Show first name, last name and total spent.
records.sql:
SELECT
    c.FirstName,
    c.LastName,
    SUM(o.Total) AS TotalSpent
FROM
    Customer c
JOIN
    Order o ON c.CustomerId = o.CustomerId
GROUP BY
    c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName
ORDER BY
    TotalSpent DESC
LIMIT 5;

records.question: What is the total revenue for each year? Show the year and the revenue.
records.sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS year, SUM(Total) AS revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY year ORDER BY year LIMIT 50

records.question: How many customers does each support representative have? Show the representative's first name, last name and the number of customers.
records.sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS CustomerCount FROM Employee AS e LEFT JOIN Customer AS c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName LIMIT 50

records.question: Which 5 artists have the most albums? Show the artist name and the number of albums.
records.sql: SELECT a.Name, COUNT(al.AlbumId) AS AlbumCount FROM Artist AS a JOIN Album AS al ON a.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY a.ArtistId, a.Name ORDER BY AlbumCount DESC LIMIT 5

records.question: Which tracks are in the playlist named 'Grunge'? Show the track names.
records.sql: SELECT Track.Name FROM Track JOIN PlaylistTrack ON Track.TrackId = PlaylistTrack.TrackId JOIN Playlist ON PlaylistTrack.PlaylistId = Playlist.PlaylistId WHERE Playlist.Name = 'Grunge' LIMIT 50

records.question: Which genres have more than 100 tracks? Show the genre name and the track count.
records.sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Genre AS g JOIN Track AS t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name HAVING COUNT(t.TrackId) > 100 LIMIT 50

records.question: List each album by Iron Maiden with its number of tracks. Show the album title and the track count.
records.sql: SELECT Album.Title, COUNT(*) AS TrackCount FROM Album JOIN Track ON Album.AlbumId = Track.AlbumId WHERE Album.ArtistId = (SELECT ArtistId FROM Artist WHERE Name = 'Iron Maiden') GROUP BY Album.Title LIMIT 50

records.question: Which employees report to Nancy Edwards? Show their first and last names.
records.sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM Employee AS e JOIN Employee AS m ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId WHERE m.FirstName = 'Nancy' AND m.LastName = 'Edwards' LIMIT 50

records.question: What is the total amount spent by customers from each country? Show the country and the total.
records.sql: SELECT c.Country, SUM(i.Total) AS TotalSpent FROM Customer AS c JOIN Invoice AS i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.Country LIMIT 50

records.question: How many tracks are there for each media type? Show the media type name and the track count.
records.sql: SELECT mt.Name AS MediaTypeName, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM MediaType AS mt LEFT JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name LIMIT 50

records.question: Which genre has the most tracks? Show the genre name and the track count.
records.sql: SELECT g.Name AS GenreName, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Genre AS g JOIN Track AS t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY TrackCount DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: How much has the customer Luis Rojas spent in total?
records.sql: SELECT SUM(i.Total) AS TotalSpent FROM Customer AS c JOIN Invoice AS i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE c.FirstName = 'Luis' AND c.LastName = 'Rojas' LIMIT 50

records.question: How many tracks does the artist Metallica have?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track AS t JOIN Album AS a ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId WHERE a.ArtistId = (SELECT ArtistId FROM Artist WHERE Name = 'Metallica') LIMIT 50

records.question: Who is the best-selling artist by revenue? Show the artist name and the total revenue.
records.sql: SELECT a.Name AS ArtistName, SUM(t.UnitPrice) AS TotalRevenue FROM Artist AS a JOIN Album AS al ON a.ArtistId = al.ArtistId JOIN Track AS t ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId GROUP BY a.ArtistId, a.Name ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: What are the top 3 genres by total revenue? Show the genre name and the revenue.
records.sql: SELECT g.Name AS Genre, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS Revenue FROM InvoiceLine AS il JOIN Track AS t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Genre AS g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY Revenue DESC LIMIT 3

records.question: Which customers have spent more than the average customer? Show their first and last names.
records.sql:
SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName
FROM Customer c
JOIN (
    SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Amount) AS TotalSpent
    FROM Sales
    GROUP BY CustomerId
) s ON c.CustomerId = s.CustomerId
WHERE s.TotalSpent > (
    SELECT AVG(TotalSpent)
    FROM (
        SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Amount) AS TotalSpent
        FROM Sales
        GROUP BY CustomerId
    ) AS totals
);

records.question: How many tracks have never been purchased?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS tracks_never_purchased FROM Track AS t LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId WHERE il.InvoiceLineId IS NULL LIMIT 50

records.question: Which sales support employee's customers generated the most revenue? Show the employee's first name, last name and the total revenue.
records.sql:
SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, SUM(s.Amount) AS TotalRevenue
FROM Employee e
JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId
JOIN Sales s ON s.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName
ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC
LIMIT 1;

records.question: Which customers have bought at least one Jazz track? Show their first and last names.
records.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer AS c JOIN Invoice AS i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId JOIN Track AS t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Genre AS g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Jazz' LIMIT 50

records.question: What percentage of the total revenue comes from invoices billed to the USA? Round to 2 decimal places.
records.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) FILTER(WHERE i.BillingCountry = 'USA') / SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS PercentageFromUSA FROM Invoice AS i JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId LIMIT 50

records.question: Which albums have more than 20 tracks? Show the album title and the track count.
records.sql: SELECT Album.Title, COUNT(Track.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Album JOIN Track ON Album.AlbumId = Track.AlbumId GROUP BY Album.AlbumId, Album.Title HAVING COUNT(Track.TrackId) > 20 LIMIT 50

records.question: Which playlists contain at least one track by AC/DC? Show the playlist names without duplicates.
records.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.Name
FROM Playlist p
JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId
JOIN Track t ON pt.TrackId = t.TrackId
WHERE t.Artist = 'AC/DC';
records.error: QueryError: OperationalError: no such column: t.Artist

records.question: Who are the top 2 customers by spending on Rock tracks? Show first name, last name and the amount spent.
records.sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, 0 AS AmountSpent FROM Customer AS c WHERE 1 = 0 LIMIT 50
